Abstract: 
In multi-domain learning, where a single model is trained across diverse data domains, the order in which data from these domains is utilized during training can significantly influence the model's performance on each domain. This paper introduces a theoretical framework that investigates the influence of training order (or data mixing) in multi-domain learning using Lie bracket computations of loss vector fields.
